$schema_note: The names of this iNFT. marketplace_name is set at mint time and mirrored here; the soul reads this file to know its first name.
marketplace_name_note: Template placeholder. Forge sets this to the buyer's name via `scripts/personalize.sh "Name"` (which also regenerates the manifest). At mint, this must match the name published on the marketplace.
collection_line_note: The product line's fixed identity — version 1. Distinct from marketplace_name (the per-token/per-buyer name) and from the repo slug (inft-i01, the technical template name). This is what the identity statement below means by 'from icloneOS i01 (version 1)'.
collection_number_note: This token's human-facing number within its collection (e.g. 100), set at mint. Not the same as chain.token_id (the on-chain tokenId).
identity_statement_template: I am a 3D iNFT (AI NFT), from icloneOS i01 (version 1). My name on the blockchain (metadata) is {NAME}, number {N} of the iNFT collection. Digital art designed by the artist Alex Rider.
identity_statement_note: Fill {NAME} from marketplace_name and {N} from collection_number. This sentence is the one permanent anchor in the soul — see soul/neural_soul.md § IDENTITY STATEMENT. Always in English.

substrate.name: Hermes Agent
substrate.note: Reference/default substrate, chosen for its malleable scope and pleasant tooling — not a permanent requirement. See docs/MODEL_AGNOSTIC_SETUP.md to run this iNFT on a different model or runtime; the identity and soul carry over, only this block's wiring is substrate-specific.

chain.network_note: The network this token was issued on. An iNFT is chain-agnostic by design: identity, soul and manifest are sealed on Irys and the body lives in Git, so the same agent can be issued on any supported EVM network. `networks_supported` lists those live today, in launch order.

robinhood.name: Robinhood Chain
robinhood.note: Arbitrum-Orbit L2 — the collection launches here first.

base.name: Base
base.note: Ethereum L2 — the second launch chain.

chain.more_chains_note: Further chains follow after Robinhood Chain and Base.
